intent: Split Settings, History, Activity and About into an on-demand Qt helper that exits after its final view closes. Preserve the resident tray, hotkeys, clipboard, accepted operations, native dialogs/fonts, safe drafts, exact remote deletion, CLI/MCP compatibility and version agreement; measure total live-process memory rather than shifting counters.

findings.title: Version mismatch gives ineffective retry advice and a successful launcher exit
findings.why_it_matters: Replacing the installed helper while the old resident runs correctly fails the required build check, but the UI tells users to retry from the tray, which cannot recover. A second launcher ignores the structured failure and exits successfully. Explicit restart guidance and failure propagation are needed.
findings.validation_reason: Replacing putgd-ui with a different build while the resident remains running reaches the newly introduced helper path in src/main.cpp:137 and strict rejection in src/ui/main.cpp:33-34, but src/app/UiProcessController.cpp:8-9,106 recommends retrying the same incompatible executable, src/ui/TrayController.cpp:77-78 displays that message, and src/main.cpp:39-42,76 returns success without inspecting the failure response; the split newly exposes this upgrade failure, and installed-upgrade incidence was not measured.

findings.title: UI activation can outlast client deadlines and succeed after reported failure
findings.why_it_matters: A helper that stalls beyond fifteen seconds makes CLI and SessionClient disconnect before the twenty-second activation timeout returns ui_show_timeout. Cold startup can add ten seconds first. Clients receive a generic transport failure and the view may still appear later.
findings.validation_reason: For a helper that becomes ready but stalls before acknowledging activation beyond fifteen seconds, src/app/UiProcessController.cpp:15-21,74,90 permits ten seconds of startup followed by twenty seconds for acknowledgement while the newly asynchronous src/app/LocalServer.cpp:84-87 withholds its response, so src/cli/main.cpp:22 and src/client/SessionClient.cpp:87-92,162-169 expire first; client disconnection only removes the reply socket under LocalServer.cpp:53,65-66 and does not cancel activation, allowing a later shown frame at UiProcessController.cpp:111-122, with stall incidence unmeasured.

findings.suggested_fix: Track pending reload/discard transitions and reject checkpointing with request_awaiting_acceptance until the authoritative document has reached the controls. Preserve dirty state until success. findings.title: Closing during Reload or Cancel can restore discarded edits as clean
findings.why_it_matters: Reload and Cancel clear dirty/conflict before their asynchronous refresh replaces the controls. Final close can checkpoint those old controls as clean and exit first. On reopen with unchanged configuration revisions, the discarded values return and are not refreshed.
findings.validation_reason: If final close wins the race against Reload or Cancel with unchanged authoritative revisions, src/ui/SettingsWindow.cpp:167,225 has already cleared dirty while src/ui/UiSession.cpp:11-15,24-25 still awaits asynchronous refresh, the new saveViewState guard at SettingsWindow.cpp:248 omits both transitions and exports old controls as clean at :251, UiApplicationController.cpp:162-167,124-129 accepts that checkpoint and exits without draining them, and SettingsWindow.cpp:259-270 restores the old values without refreshing matching revisions; this ordering is reachable through those callers, but its runtime incidence was not measured.

findings.title: Native plugin stdout can corrupt control frames and prevent window startup
findings.why_it_matters: QApplication loads native plugins before stdout is isolated from the JSON control pipe. GTK/GLib debug output reaches that pipe, causing ui_protocol and helper termination before a view opens. The caller reproduced this with production helper startup/stdio sources reported unchanged from the frozen review.
findings.validation_reason: When a native plugin emits stdout diagnostics, newly added src/ui/main.cpp:16 constructs QApplication before transport setup and src/ui/StdioDevice.cpp:12-16,49-52 shares STDOUT_FILENO with that output, while src/app/UiProcessController.cpp:48-52 routes stdout into UiControl.cpp:57-61 and terminates the helper on failure at UiProcessController.cpp:167-171; the supplied production-helper reproduction reports ui_protocol with xcb, gtk3 and G_MESSAGES_DEBUG=all and corroborates this path, with relevant startup/stdio files reported unchanged but no claim that the whole later binary matches the frozen tree.

triage_groups.context: Version skew, slow activation and native plugin stdout can each prevent callers from obtaining a usable helper window.
triage_groups.preferred_resolution: Isolate protocol descriptors before native plugin startup (#4), then provide restart guidance and launcher error propagation (#1), and align complete activation deadlines with clients (#2). Validate each trigger independently.
triage_groups.why: These changes concern helper startup and activation outcomes while retaining strict private protocol validation and build agreement.

residual_risks: A failed GNOME SetUiProcess(0) call leaves uiProcessError_ set while ready_ stays true (src/platform/gnome/GnomeAdapter.cpp:45,73-83,108,116). Window hotkeys then fail until the helper is opened again or Shell rediscovery succeeds. Tray-triggered capture failure opens Activity and can itself trigger successful re-registration (src/ui/TrayController.cpp:20-23); hotkey failures only log in src/main.cpp:107. This is a conditional recovery risk, not evidence that a transient clear failure occurred. Prefer retrying the clear while preserving fail-closed registration when a helper is live.

Setup status recovery after a transient inspect failure or eviction is incomplete: SettingsWindow::pollSetup stops polling but retains the first job (src/ui/SettingsWindow.cpp:279-282), while SetupService keeps only 64 completed jobs (src/app/SetupService.cpp:62-71). A saved ID evicted during helper absence can repeatedly return setup_not_found and delay later jobs until its entry is replaced or discarded. The failed job does re-enable its own destination-test button; the peer claim that the button necessarily stays disabled was not retained. Incidence was not measured.

The memory benefit of the split remains unmeasured. The resident retains Qt Widgets for its tray and capture; the checkpoint is capped at 8 MiB. Compare total resident-plus-helper RSS/PSS/private memory and reopen latency across cold idle, visible populated views, final close and post-capture/upload/history workloads. The 40 MiB figure remains a target.
testing_gaps: U11/AE17 current-source graphical acceptance remains pending on Cinnamon/X11, GNOME/Wayland and KDE/Wayland. Use visible VNC evidence for every tray action with the helper absent, hotkey and clipboard continuity, an accepted operation surviving final close, safe drafts/conflicts, native fonts/folder dialogs, focus races and exclusion of every helper view/modal from active-window capture. Offscreen or fixture tests cannot satisfy these compositor gates.

Production-helper final-close/reopen is not covered end to end: tests/integration/test_ui_process.cpp:37-43 uses ui_helper_fixture, tests/gui/test_ui_application.cpp uses an in-process ControlDevice, and tests/integration/test_ui_split_services.cpp:20-29 launches production putgd-ui but kills its first instance and explicitly shuts down the second. Add a real helper scenario that edits a nonsecret draft, closes its final view, observes PID zero, reopens Settings and verifies draft plus conflict revisions through the actual bootstrap and close handshake.

Child sanitizer teardown evidence is not established by the passing parent integration test. The supervisor drains child stderr at src/app/UiProcessController.cpp:53-55 and discards exit code/status at :175; stopping_ makes any child termination expected at :177-195. tests/integration/test_ui_split_services.cpp:29 asserts only the shutdown callback. A sanitizer diagnostic or nonzero child exit during shutdown can therefore be hidden from that parent result. Add a test-only, secret-safe way to assert the production helper exit status and collect sanitizer failure status; prove it with a synthetic failing child. No actual sanitizer defect is alleged by this coverage gap.
Final total-process memory and reopen-latency measurements with source/package/process identities remain pending under U11. Keep their native evidence distinct from the headless test receipts.
The separate optional MCP integration suite was not executed by these reviewers. Retain a current receipt for the production CLI-forwarding contracts when completing final split verification.

Fix stdout isolation (#4), version-skew recovery and launcher failure propagation (#1), activation deadlines (#2), and reload/Cancel checkpoint ordering (#3), then verify the updated code.
